book.name: MARK
book.title: Id ash d Mark Oꞌohana ab Amjed g Jiosh Alidag.

content: Mamtsh am i bei g Jesus geꞌe kownal wui

Tsh am wabsh i chum mahsi. Tsh am ep e nam hegam uꞌugchu papal ch geꞌeged ch chehanig t‑mashchamdam mo d e jehnigiddam k atsh am i mamche mat has hahawa ep wo e juh. Tsh am i kuhgit g ha‑namki. Kutsh am si maniadad g Jesus nohnhoi k gam hu be k am uꞌapa heg wui mo d kownal ch hab chehgig Pilate ab abchudch mo chum e kownalchud.
Kush ihda Pilate ab kakke g Jesus, “No wa woho mapsh hab chum e elid map d ha‑kownalig idam Tutuligo hemajkam?” Sh hab kaij g Jesus, “Dani ahni.”
Sh g uꞌugchu papal muꞌi haꞌichu ab abchud. Sh pi am hu has shaꞌi kaij g Jesus.
Sh g Pilate ab ep kakke, “Neh, muꞌi haꞌichu o ab m‑abchud. Napt pi am hu has wo shaꞌi chei ab amjed?”
Kush ep pi am hu has shaꞌi ha kaij g Jesus. Tsh g Pilate si has i e taht heg hekaj.
Mamtsh ab mohtoꞌi g Jesus mat wo muh
K am hab e wua ahid ab id eda gegosig mo g kownal am hema i dadagitod g lihso am ha wehhejed g hemajkam.
Kush eda am haꞌi kuhpi g lilso matsh haꞌi ha kokda am i chum wushshadch g kownal. Sh hema hab chehgig idam Barabbas.
Kutsh g hemajkam ab i kakke g Pilate matsh am hab hig wo ha juni hegai mash chum hekid am hab ha wuijid.
Sh g Pilate ab ha kakke, “Pegih, nam hab elid mant id am wo i dagito am em‑wehhejed mash d em‑kownalig?” nash pi chum s‑dagitoimk g Jesus
ch hab ha elid mo d waꞌi idam uꞌugchu papal ch s‑hehgamk ch s‑muꞌamk.
Kutsh wabshaba g uꞌugchu papal am i ha cheha g hemajkam matsh hab wo chei matsh g Barabbas wo e dagito. Kutsh wa woho am hab e juh.
Kush hab ep kaij g Pilate, “Pegih, kunt has wo juh ihda oꞌodham mam hab aꞌaga mo d em‑kownalig?”
Kush si s‑kaidam hab kaij g hemajkam, “Muꞌani ab kots t ab!”
Kutsh hab chum chei g Pilate, “Haschu ahg? Shahchu at hig pi ap has juh?” Kush oi wa wabsh baꞌich i si s‑kaidam hab wabsh ge kaij muꞌikko, “Muꞌani! Muꞌani ab kots t ab.”

Kush g Pilate tatchua mat wo s‑hohhoꞌi g hemajkam ch atsh heg hekaj am i dagito g Barabbas am ha wui k am ha cheha g shondal mat am wo gewitta g Jesus. Kumtsh wa woho hab juh. Tsh am hahawa ha wui dagito matsh gam hu wo be k ab wo naggia kots t ab.
Mash g shondal wabsh nahnko wua g Jesus
Kutsh gam hu hahawa i bei g shondal g Jesus kownal geꞌe kih am k am wehs ha wai g e‑wehm shondal.
Kutsh am i e hemapad k nahnko wua. Msh wa ab abchud mash chum e kownalchud. Pegih, tsh ab wahki g kownal eniga k ge hoꞌi gihkot k ab wahki moꞌoj ab.
Kush hab wabsh s‑ahgamk ch hab kaij, “Tash g d ha‑kownaligk g Tutuligo hemajkam.”
Tsh haꞌi an si gewitta moꞌoj an g uhskaj k ab siswuimad k ab wui i shul pehegia ab has elidch.
Kumtsh am i haꞌasa nahnkogid k am si wuahawua hegai kownal eniga k ab uhpam wahki g enigaj k gam hu hahawa i bei mat ab wo naggia kots t ab.
Mamtsh ab naggia g Jesus kots t ab

D ab hema i ha nam g oꞌodham ch ab him Jerusalem wui ch ash hab chehgig Simon. Id ad an bei g shondal k ab kushwiotach hegai kots mamt ab ab wo naggia g Jesus. Ihda Simon ash ab d kihkam Cyrene kihhim t ab ch d ha‑ohg idam Alexander ch Rufus.
Kumd gam hu i bei g Jesus mam am ha nahngia. K hab e aꞌaga amai Golgotha mo id hab d ahga Koshwak.
Kumd am chum iꞌich g nawait ch kulani mat wo hehogih g s‑koꞌok. Kud pi shaꞌi ih g Jesus.
Kumd ab hahawa sisish kots t ab k am kei g kots. D am haꞌi e chichwi g shondal k wo nei mas hedai haschu wo bei g haꞌichu enigaj.
K eda ga hu i juhk madki heki hu e ai g humukt ohla mamd ab naggia kots t ab.
D an oꞌohanas g ha‑abchuda ab dahm mo ab i moꞌokch g Jesus ch hab chuꞌig, “Id o d ha‑Kownalig g Tutuligo Hemajkam.”
Kumd gohk ab ep ha nahngia kokots t ab gan hu aꞌai. Sh eda d s‑chu eꞌeskam idam. [
Kum hab masma am chehgidch mam hab elid mo g Jesus hab waꞌap d pi ap hemajkam. Neh, heki o hu an oꞌohanas Jiosh oꞌohana ed mat id am hab wo e juh.]
D hegam mo am bihbimhim nahnko ahg ch hab ahg, “Naptsh woho wo i wua g geꞌe cheopi k am uhpam ep wo i kei waik tash ab?
Pegih, ab g hig i huduni kots t amjed k wo e doꞌibia maptp wo e nako.”
D g uꞌugchu papal ch chehanig t‑mashchamdam am hab waꞌap nahnko ahg hab kaijch ab aꞌai e wui, “Id atsh haꞌi ha doꞌibia k atki wabshaba pi wo e nako mas wo hejel e doꞌibia.
Nash hig pi woho d Jiosh si Kehsha ch d t‑kownalig? Pegih, tt ab wo s‑wohoch matp ab wo i huduni k wo e doꞌibia.” D hegam ehp mad ab wehmaj nahngia hab waꞌap nahnko ahg.
Matsh muh g Jesus
D am i dahm juh. D wehsko gei g s‑chuhugam waik ohla ab.
D am i e ai g waik ohla. D si s‑kaidam hab kaij g Jesus, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabaktani.” Id o hab d ahga, “Ni‑Jioshga, ni‑Jioshga, pt haschu ahgk wabsh ni‑dagito?”
D haꞌijj hab kaij hegam mad am gegok, “Nehꞌe, Elijabad o ab chum waid.”
Kud am hema med k an haꞌichu usko mad am wakch nawait ch ed k am uhgk i be k ab chum iꞌich g Jesus k hab chei, “Kia koi, tt hig wo nei mas ia wo jiwia g Elijabad k ab wo i huduni.”
Kud am si s‑kaidam haꞌichu hab ep chei g Jesus k am hahawa i muh.
Kutsh hegai s‑kowk ikus kuhpadag mash am s‑tadnim naggia ged hu si eda g geꞌe cheopi ab si shel e wantsh.
D hegai moki d shondal ha‑geꞌejig gahab kehk kots wui ch am kah g Jesus ch am neid mat has masma muh ch hab kaij, “Ihda oki si s‑wohom d alidaj g Jiosh.”
D ga hu sha mehkjed g uꞌuwi ab haꞌi neid mat haschu has e juh. Haꞌi idam o d Salome ch Mary Magdalene ch hegai Mary mo d ha‑jeꞌe idam James ch Joses.
Idam waik ash am wehmaj oiopohim g Jesus ch haꞌichukaj i wehmt mo eda gam hu oimmelhim Galilee chekshani ch ed. Kud muꞌi idam uꞌuwi am wehmaj ab i hihi g Jesus Jerusalem wui.
Matsh ged hu e cheh g Jesus

D am haꞌichug hegai e jehnigiddam mo ab Arimathea t amjed ch hab chehgig Joseph. Id o si s‑ap d oꞌodham ch ab s‑neidamk g Jiosh kownaltalig. D eda e aihim mat wo i hud. Kuchd eda am chum t‑nakog matt baꞌich i tash wo chum t‑mihshmad. D heg hekaj am hih ihda Joseph k atsh ab tai g kownal g Jesus honshpadag.
Kush g Pilate hab kaij, “A nat wa s‑wohom heki hu i muh?” atsh am hahawa wai g shondal ha‑geꞌejig.
Sh id hab kaij mat heki hu muh. Kush hab hahawa ahg g Joseph mo am wa s‑ape mat am wo bei.

Kutsh g Joseph am him k am ha nolawt g si s‑kehg ikus k am ep jiwia. Kumd am wehhejed ab i huduni g Jesus honshpadag. K am mia hab chuꞌig g hihaꞌini ch ab heki hu cheotas hodai ch ed. Kumd am i be k ged hu heg eda cheh am i hobinodk heg hekaj s‑kehg ikus. Kumd ab hahawa kuh g geꞌe hodaikaj.
D g Mary Magdalene ch hegai Mary mo d ha‑jeꞌe g James ch Joses am wa neid mad hebai e cheh.
